intro03:
That's strange... I can't remember anything.
Not even my own name...
intro04:
...Hm?
There’s a bag lying over there.
intro05:
There are some strange balls inside the bag.
What could these be?
intro06:
...Whoa! Something just came out of one!
I've never seen a creature like this... but it doesn't seem dangerous.
intro07:
Looking further inside the bag, I find a small booklet.
'A Beginner's Guide to Pokémon Adventures'... ?
intro08:
Pokémon... Is that what these creatures are called?
All right. I'd better read this first.
battle:
'Adventure Guide: Pokémon Battles'
Pokémon fight using moves. Each move has its own power, accuracy, and a limited number of uses (PP).
Reduce the opponent's HP to zero to win. Heal your Pokémon when its HP gets low.
capture:
'Adventure Guide: Catching Pokémon'
Throw a Poké Ball at a wild Pokémon to try to add it to your team.
Lowering its HP or giving it a status condition can make catching it easier. A fainted Pokémon cannot be caught.
switch:
'Adventure Guide: Switching Pokémon'
In battle, you can switch the Pokémon currently fighting with another member of your team.
If the matchup looks bad, consider switching. Be careful: your opponent may attack while you do.
type:
'Adventure Guide: Type Matchups'
Pokémon and moves have types. Depending on the matchup, a move may be super effective, not very effective, or have no effect at all.
Check your opponent's type and choose your moves carefully.
biome:
'Adventure Guide: Habitats'
Different Pokémon live in different places, such as forests, caves, rivers, and mountains.
When you reach a new area, see which Pokémon appear there. Your route may change as you travel.
starterUnlock:
'Adventure Guide: Partners for Future Adventures'
As you encounter new Pokémon and continue exploring, more Pokémon may become available to select as starters in future adventures.
Meet new partners and gain experience together.
growth:
'Adventure Guide: Pokémon Growth'
Pokémon gain experience from battles and become stronger as they level up.
Some learn new moves or evolve. Check how your partners change as you grow together.
wave05:
'Adventure Guide: HP and Fainting'
HP is a Pokémon's health. When it reaches zero, the Pokémon faints and cannot battle.
Use Potions to restore HP, and items such as Revives to help fainted Pokémon.
wave08:
'Adventure Guide: PP'
Every move has a limited number of uses called PP.
When PP runs out, that move cannot be used normally. Use moves thoughtfully and restore PP when needed.
wave10:
'Adventure Guide: Three Move Categories'
Physical moves usually use Attack and Defense; special moves usually use Sp. Atk and Sp. Def.
Status moves generally affect stats, conditions, or the battlefield instead of dealing direct damage.
wave15:
'Adventure Guide: Power and Accuracy'
A move with higher power usually deals more damage. Accuracy affects whether the move hits.
Even a powerful move may miss. Choose moves to fit the situation.
wave16:
'Adventure Guide: Type Matchups'
Pokémon and moves have types. For example, Fire is strong against Grass but weak against Water.
Some attacks are super effective, some are resisted, and some have no effect at all.
wave20:
'Adventure Guide: Stats'
Attack and Defense usually matter for physical moves; Sp. Atk and Sp. Def for special moves.
Speed usually determines who acts first, while HP shows how much damage a Pokémon can take.
wave22:
'Adventure Guide: Stat Changes'
Moves and Abilities can raise or lower stats such as Attack, Defense, and Speed during a battle.
Weakening an opponent or boosting your team can be a strong strategy.
wave25:
'Adventure Guide: Switching'
If your Pokémon has a bad matchup or is low on HP, you can switch to another teammate.
But the opponent can usually act during a switch, so be careful.
wave26:
'Adventure Guide: Status Conditions'
Poison deals ongoing damage; burns deal damage and weaken most physical attacks; paralysis slows Pokémon and may prevent actions.
Sleep and freezing also restrict actions. Keep status-healing items ready.
wave30:
'Adventure Guide: Healing Items'
Potions restore HP, while status-healing items cure conditions such as poison or paralysis.
Fainted partners need special recovery items. Check your Bag before difficult battles.
wave32:
'Adventure Guide: Held Items'
Some items grant effects when held by a Pokémon in battle.
Different items help in different situations. Read their descriptions and give them to suitable partners.
wave35:
'Adventure Guide: Experience and Levels'
Pokémon gain experience through battles and level up after gaining enough.
Leveling up improves stats, and some Pokémon learn new moves.
wave36:
'Adventure Guide: Evolution'
Some Pokémon evolve when they reach a certain level or meet special conditions.
Evolution can change their appearance and abilities. Not every Pokémon evolves.
wave40:
'Adventure Guide: Habitats and Exploration'
Different Pokémon live in forests, rivers, mountains, caves, and other places.
Pay attention to your surroundings on unfamiliar routes, and look for signposts.
wave45:
A low, heavy mechanical hum echoes in the distance.
Huh? A huge shadow just passed overhead.
It didn't look like a bird or a Pokémon... What was that?
A sign reads: 'Rogue Expedition Team — Investigating Uncharted Regions and Unexplained Phenomena.'
Maybe I can find someone if I follow these markers.
wave49:
I've reached a place where the flying craft has come down to rest.
Up close, it really does look like a ship that can sail through the sky.
It bears the same symbol as the signpost.
...I think I've finally found the Rogue Expedition Team.
wave46:
...Look! Something's floating in the sky.
There's a ship-like structure hanging beneath a great, round balloon.
Is that some kind of aircraft people can ride? I've never seen anything like it...
wave48:
It's getting closer.
I can make out windows and all kinds of equipment beneath that enormous balloon.
Could that be the Rogue Expedition Team's flying base from the sign?
All right. Just a little farther.
ending01: Wigglytuff: Wigglytuff~! Looks like we have a visitor!
ending02: Captain R: Oh? A new face! You made it all the way here alone? Impressive!
ending03: Captain R: I am Captain R, leader of the Rogue Expedition Team. This is my longtime partner, Wigglytuff.
ending04: Player: Actually... I woke up somewhere unfamiliar. I cannot even remember who I am.
ending05: Captain R: I see. You need not find every answer right away.
ending06: Captain R: We are investigating strange, unexplained events and uncharted regions ourselves.
ending07: Captain R: Why not rest here for a while? And if you are willing, perhaps you could lend our team a hand.
ending09: Captain R: Ha ha! Welcome aboard. Glad to have you with us!
